title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning?
description:
What If Earth Stopped Spinning?

If the ground stopped and the air did not, the air at the equator would keep going at more than 1,500 km/h, faster than sound.

Sources: World Meteorological Organization, Archive of Weather and Climate Extremes (highest gust 408 km/h, Barrow Island, 10 April 1996). Equatorial rotation about 1,670 km/h. Speed of sound at sea level about 1,235 km/h.
https://wmo.asu.edu/content/world-highest-wind-gust-recorded-cyclone

Pictures: NASA EPIC imagery. Facts: every number is checked against the source above.
Image credits: NASA.
